0022600089.text: Both the Utah Jazz and the Memphis Grizzlies open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with Utah on the road. The Jazz are without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) and Kyle Filipowski (day-to-day, back, game-time decision), while the Grizzlies are without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Utah won the last meeting 147-101 on April 10, 2026, in Salt Lake City. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Jazz a 55% chance to win.
